Service Flow

Five Steps. Zero Surprises.

From your first request to port delivery, Chamorro handles every step.

01
Submit Request
Tell us your make, model, budget, and specs via the request form.
02
Vehicle Matching
Our team scans auction listings to find vehicles that match your criteria.
03
Bidding & Winning
We bid on your behalf. You receive the result and exact price immediately.
04
Docs & Customs
Full export documentation and customs clearance handled from our Kawasaki and Okinawa offices.
05
Delivery to Port
Safe transport to your nominated destination port, with tracking support through to arrival.

Compliance

Auction Compliance

This platform is designed in full compliance with Japanese auto auction regulations.

Regulation Requirement How Chamorro Complies
Auction listing data must not be published externally This site displays no auction listings. We collect buyer requirements internally and match them in-house.
Only registered members may bid Chamorro bids as a registered member on your behalf. You never interact with the auction directly.
Auction-style interfaces are prohibited This site is a Chamorro service platform — not an auction search engine. No listing browse or search features exist.
By working through a compliant member like Chamorro, you benefit from accurate grading, official documentation, and a trustworthy process. Our compliance is your protection.
